tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// zab mo nang don gyi mchan bu mngon sum lam byed bzhugs so//

༄༅// srid zhi'i dpal ni bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes rdo rje des mi mthun phyogs 'joms pas 'chang de so so rang gi rig pa la gzhi lam 'bras gsum las da res 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya ji lta ji snyed thams cad mkhyen khyab 'jug dang nyan rang sogs byis pa rnams la thams cad mkhyen par grags pa dang mi mtshungs cing thams thugs kyi mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs par byas na'ang rung cad kyi mtshan nyid chags thogs med par mngon sum gzigs/ rang gi rtogs kyang gzhan la mi ston pa'i rang rgyal lta bu min pas phyi 'jig rten nang rdo rje'i lus gzhan dbang skyed rim gsum de nyid phyag chen snang stong dbyer med ston/ bstan nas kyang gnas skabs bzhi yi snang bas rgyud dkrugs pa'i 'khrul pa sel zhing sku'i 'bras bu mngon sum ston pa'i/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i dpal ldan de'i gong na gzhan med pa'i bla ma la sangs rgyas dang dbyer med phyag 'tshal/ sems can rnams dang lhan bla ma de nyid rnam pa dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bstan pa ni skyes chos sku bde chen nyag gcig dngos bden gnyis kyi dbang gi sku gnyis kyi bdag nyid/ sku ni gsum rtsa sku rlung gsung*/ thig le thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin can sku sprul sku gsung longs sku thugs chos sku/ gnas skabs bzhi po ni sems can gyi tshe sgrib bcas sangs rgyas tshe sgrib med kyi sku bzhi nyid/ sbyangs gzhi sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras kyi dbye bas rnam snang sogs sku lnga'i bdag nyid la rigs ni lnga po de nyid las/ stong phrag du ma skye sa pa nyid/ de phyir 'di dag rang bzhin gcig /bde chen mchog tu phan pa nyid ces pa'i don phyag 'tshal/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum la phyag 'tshal ba ni dngos sems nyid chos sku bde stong dbyer med kyi gcig chos rten 'brel snang tsam gyi

kun de'i rang bzhin can yin la 'di la/ yod med sogs mtha' thams cad dang bral bas rtsa dbu ma rlung dbu ma thig le dbu ma'i rang bzhin bde chen snang stong dbyer med pra phab pa lta bu rnam kun mchog ldan nyid/ de yang gang sbyor lam chos mchog gi mthar skyes pa'i mthong lam de sngags lugs su dbang ngam sgom stobs kyi mchog dga'i ma mtha' dga' bral gyi ya mthar skyes pa'i lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin can/ rdo rje phag mo sogs ming gi bod pa'i lha mo phyag gi yul don dam rnams la rang rig dang kun rdzob rnams la brda'i de la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud sde 'og ma rnams kun tu gsang ba rtsa rlung thig le dang 'dod yon lam byed dbang gong ma'i dpe don gyi ye shes rtags dang rtags can sor sdud sangs rgyas kyi yon tan tshang bar sems can bzhugs tshul gang*/ rgyal bas bla na med pa'i rgyud du par phye yang*/ mtha' dgongs dgongs min drang nges sgra ji bzhin ji bzhin ma yin pa drug gis bcings pas rtogs dka' bo khyad par lus sems nang gi don/ phyi nang pa'i nyan thos dang nyan thos bye mdo dang rang rang rgyal gyis spyod yul min/ pha rol phyin par phyogs re zhugs pa tshogs lam lta bu las dang po pa dang stong pa nyid kyis sems g.yengs pa rnams la rab gsang rang gsang du gnas ba/ rtsa rlung thig le dang lus rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi sems sems gnas tshul spyi dang bye brag de gnyis dang dbyer med du til la til mar ltar gnas pa'i nang gi bdag nyid dam snying po rdo rje'i lus sems sku gnyis kyi rigs 'dra de bshad/ gdod nas rang bzhin la dri med rgyal ba'i thams cad kyi ngo bo'am gshis tshul yin pas snying po rdo rje'i lus sems rang bzhin dag kyang dri ma glo bur ldan pa dang*/ rang bzhin dag kyang dri ma glo bur dag pa dang*/ yon tan gsar thob med kyang dri ma bsal bas thob pa dang*/

mdzad pa rnam rtog med kyang gdul bya'i skal ba dang mtshams pa ra 'jug pa ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas bzhis 'khyud pa'i shun bcas nor bu lta bu ni/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas ma dag ma dag 'di gnyis kyi tshe rigs zhes bya dag pa dang*/ shin tu rnam dag de'i tshe chos sku zhes bya de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med pas de bzhin nyid ces bya go rim bzhin/ sems can lam la gnas pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs rnams rim pa bzhin ming gi rnam grangs gzhi lam 'bras bu dang*/ rgyu rgyud thabs rgyud 'bras rgyud dang*/ gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs lam gyi rim pa 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa sogs gsungs pa'i snga ma ni nyer len gyi rgyu/ bar ma ni lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen/ 'bras bu yang gdod nas yod pa mi gsal ba gsal bar byas pa yin gyi/ sngon med gsar skyed ni min/ de lta na yang sems can gyi dus sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dngos su med kyang yon tan thams cad dbyer med zho dang 'o ma lta bur bzhed do// gsungs phyir rgyu lus sems dbyer med rim gnyis dbyer med kyi 'bras bu sku gnyis dbyer med thob ste rgyu la gnas pa lam la goms pas 'bras bu la mngon du 'gyur ba zhes brjod de de yang rtog pas btags tsam ste don la rgyu 'bras dbyer med do// de don rtogs par bya zhes rdo rje theg pa'i brjod bya'i ngo bo bstan nas/ rjod byed dum bu bcu gcig gi rim pa ni/ thog mar 'khor 'das spyi'i rgyu rkyen sems dngos po'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang*/ sems kyi snang ba las lus 'grub pas bstan cing de yang gtso bor mngal skyes lus ni 'grub pa'i tshul gyis bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi shes par 'gyur/ de nyid la rtsa yi gnas tshul rnam bshad dang*/ rtsa der rlung ni gnas dang rgyu ba'i tshul/ rlung dang thig le dngas snyigs kyi thig le ji ltar rgyu zhes na de gsum du slong ba dang

rnam shes lus de gnas skabs bzhir kun gzhi'i la sogs 'brel ba'i don shes na de dag lam du slong*/ de dag thams cad sems snang yin pas stong gsum yungs 'bru ltar lus snod kyi 'jig rten la sbyar ba dang*/ bden par ma grub kyang kun brtags la dbang 'byor ba'i phyir bskyed pa'i lha rnams sgom tshul gang yin dang*/ der ma zad chos nyams kyi sbyang gzhir grangs ji snyed par sbyong byed kyi gnyen po yod par bstan pa dang*/ de ltar shes nas lam gyi rim par bgrod tshul bstan pa dang*/ de rnams rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi lus sems 'jig cing bsdud pa'i tshul rnams/ rgyal bas bla med rgyud rnams su bstan pa bzhin bshad bya/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gzhi'am rgyu ni sems kyi de bzhin nyid de'i thog ma na gzhan med la/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gang rung gi rgya ra ma chad yod med gang rung gi phyogs lhung ma mchis kyang*/ de nyid kyi rnams pa ma 'gags rol pa las/ rlung dang lhan cig dngas snyigs kyi thig le ji ltar rgyu shes na de gsum lam du slong ba dang*/ ngo bo 'am rang bzhin stong la rang bzhin nam ngo bo'o gsal bas gsal stong zung 'jug chu zla lta bu 'di la tha mal shes pa chos dbyings rgyal ba'i snying po sher phyin phyag chen chos sku bde ba chen po lhan skyes ye shes dang po'i mgon po 'od gsal rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya/ rgyas 'gyur rigs kyang gsar byung min te tshogs brgyad kyi rang ngo dri ma med pa'i ye shes gzugs sku gnyis rgyas par 'gyur rgyu la bya/ rigs sad byed ni thos pa'i bag chags yang dag pa'i/ spyod bsdus sgron mar/ dang po 'od gsal zhes pa nas/ thams cad stong mdangs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zhes sogs don dam pa'i ming go gsum gsungs mchan gyi mchan/ rtog pa ste snying po nyid la brten pa yin gyi/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes la brten pa min/ 'on kyang thos pa'i bag chags dang kun gzhi'i ni chu dang 'o ma ltar rgyud gcig la gnas so// de las sems sems byung 'khor 'das kyi

rnam pa 'gag med cir yang 'char ba 'di nyid de dag pa'i sems bde gshegs snying po'o// sems de nyid yul yul can ltar snang ba'i rtsal 'gag med rang gis sgyu ma la sgyu mar rtogs pa ltar rang ngo snang stong dbyer med bden gnyis zung 'jug de ma rig pas ma dag pa'i sems kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos thams cad kyi rten nam gnas su gyur pa tshogs bdun gyi bag chags bsags pa las de byung bas 'bras bu rnam smin gyi kun gzhi des tshogs bdun bskyed pa'i rgyu byed pas rgyu sa bon gyi kun gzhi khams gsum du skye ba len pas len pa'i rnam shes zhes tshor ba btang snyoms ngo bo me long gi gsal ba ltar ma bsgribs lung ma bstan kun 'gro lngas dus rtag tu bskor ba// de'i steng du bag chags sna tshogs mi gsal ba rkyen dang phrad na 'byung ba bag 'dag sogs rtsi sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i ras tshon gyi nang du bcug pa na kha dog sna tshogs 'byung ba lta bu yang dag ma yin kun rtog sems sems byung rnams kyis 'khyud pa chu bo'i rgyun 'bab pa lta bu'o// tshul ji ltar ma rig pa'i rkyen ni kun gzhi la tshogs bdun bskyed pa dang tshogs bdun 'gag pa na de'i bag chags gzhi la 'jog pa'i las/ 'du byed pa po bdun yid kyi g.yo ba ni/ kun gzhi'i steng nas/ chu rlabs lta bur g.yos pa las ma rig go bdun yid 'di la kun gzhi'i steng nas tshogs drug bskyed byed de ma thag yid sadang de 'khrul par gyur pa'i nyon yid de cha gnyis yod pa'i tshul gi thag pa mthong ba dang de sbrul du mthong ba lta bu'o// nyon yid ni kun gzhi'i rang ngo la rmongs pa bdag tu rmongs yod nas kun gzhi la bdag tu lta ba bdag tu nga rgyal ba/ bdag la chags shing dga' ba ste nyon mongs bzhi dang dus kun tu 'grogs pas sgrib lung ma bstan no// des na yid de nyon mongs bzhis 'khyud pa'i tshe nyon yid dang bdag med rtogs pa sogs dkar po'i chos kyis 'khyud pa'i tshe dri ma med pa'i yid du bzhed do/

1 /phyi don gyi rnam pa snang ba sems rang gi yul phyi don du/ gzugs sogs drug don dang 'dzin pa rnam shes drug ste gzung 'dzin gnyis snang ba/ phyi don ched kyi sems rang gis rang la 1gtad cing 2gzung ba yin te rdo rje rtse mo las/ sa bon kun ldan kun gzhi ni/ phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid do// zhes so// kun gzhi'i rnam shes steng gi bag chags las chos sna tshogs ma 'dres par snang ba ni ngo bo nyid rnam par 'byed pa can gyi rten 'brel yin la sdug pa mtho ris dang mi sdug pa ngan song gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis las ma rig pa kun gzhi 'du byed bdun yid gnyis las bdun yid de yul la phyir 'gyus te yul dbang yid byed lta bu las gzugs sogs snang ba'i shes pa khu ba'i dbang gis yid byed/ rdul gyis yul/ rlung gis dbang po/ mchan gyi mchan no/ / snang cha las/ yul drug la phyi don du mthong zhing gzung ba'i rnam shes kyi phung po 'byung*/ de las 'bral mi 'dod cing phrad 'dod pa'i tshor ba bde ba blang dor bya dang de las bzlog pa'i sdug bsngal byed las tshor ba 'di phung po skye/ de las snang ba mched pa gzugs la rtog pa'i de'i dbang gi sngo ser sogs yul de las mtshan 'dzin 'du shes kyi phung po te/ de ltar rgyu rkyen 'dus byas nas yul snang de shes pa las gzhan du btags shing*/ bag chags rgyun brtan par zhen pas gzugs kyi phung po grub ste kun gzhi dang tshogs bdun gyi rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus pa las grub pa 'bras bu'i phung po bzhin no/ yid dang 'brel ba/ de'i don mthong bas snang ba thob pa de lta'i rdo rje'i lus ni 'byung ba'i khams lnga rnam par shes dang drug ni/ rgyu phyi snod nang bcud thams cad kyi zhes rtog pas tha snyad byas/ bdag med pa la bdag 'dzin sogs tshul min yid byed dam yang dag min rtog /de yi bag chags kun gzhi la/ bsags pa

sa bon thams cad pa de la rgyu yi rkyen phyir snang sems dbyer med/ khyad par 'byung ba'i khams phra ba dang rnam shes dbyer med zhes bya/ bdag rkyen ni yul dang shes pa'i bar du snang ba yi/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po gzugs can lnga'am yang na shes pa'i steng gi dbang shes skyed pa'i nus pa nyid yin la yid shes kyi bdag rkyen ni ye shes bskyed pa'i nus pa mthu ldan bdun yid nyid do// dmigs pa'i rkyen ni gzugs la sogs te sgra dri ro reg chos yin la/ yid chos la 'brel tshul ni rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin no// bdun yid ma thim slar shes pa rig mi 'dra gzhan gyi bar ma chod par/ yul du snang ba'i rig bya ste/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen ces pa/ 1$1000240 tshogs drug po gang gang so sor 'gags pa shes pa so sor ma 'dres par skyed byed kyi bdun yid yin pas/ gang gang skyes pa de ma thag ces pa'ang rung*/ don yid byed lta 'dod lta bu de tshogs drug gi yul rkyen 'byung na de ma thag gcig 'byung*/ mang po byung na yang de mang po 'byung ngo de ma thag des na de ma thag rkyen ni bdun yid yin te drug pa'i yid kyang de ma thag rkyen bdun yid dang bcas pa min gyi de ma thag rkyen drug yid kyi bye brag tu 'dod pa rnam par gcod pa'o// de ltar sems tsam pa'i lugs la sems byung gi rgyu rkyen rten dang dbu ma pa'i lugs la ma brtags gcig bur nyams dga' ba'i 'brel 'di pa tsam las/ ma rig pa sogs 'khor ba dang ma rig pa 'gags pa sogs myang 'das kyi rten 'brel chos kun snang bar 'gyur/ pa dang de dang mtshungs ldan gyi 'dun pa/ tshor ba la chags pa sred sdug bsngal du'ang gsungs len pa gnyis mtshams sbyar nas kun gzhi'i steng gi bag chags gsos pas srid pa 'grub 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ni 'dod chags te/ de dang 'brel bas zhe sdang*/ zhe sdang gis bdag nyid brgyal ba ste gti mug go

/'dzag sgrib kyang 'di la zer/ mchog mi 'gyur gyi bde ba'i gzhom bya'o// de yang 'chi ba'i tshe dkar dmar snying gar phrad mtshams 'pho bde skye/ des kun gzhi dbang du byed par 'gyur la/ dkar dmar gyi khams phra mo gzugs med du'ang yod par bzhed pa'o// de nas lus kyi nang gang du yod par sman gtong ba ltar 'pho ba'i bag chags gang yod sar de'i gnyen po bsten pas dkar dmar la brten nas bde ba lam byed chags lam sngags nas gtso bor gsungs pa'o// srid pa de yang gzugs med gzugs khams 'dod pa'i khams dang gsum ste/ rim bzhin gzugs sogs kyi yul la mtshan 'dzin pa/ gzugs med chung dang gzugs khams 'bring dang 'dod pa chen po yin/ thams cad rang sems chos sku snang stong dbyer med kyi gnas lugs blang dor rtog pa tshul min yid byed yi/ rgyu dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan// rnam gsum 'du byed pa'i rkyen las ni/ bde

'gro sdug bsngal can ngan 'gro snyom 'jug shes rab dang bral ba'i gzugs gzugs med bcas pa yi/ 'bras bu bskyed pa nyon mongs can/ sems nyid ma dag pa'i gnas skabs yin/ dri ma de nyid sems kyi ngo bo la ma 'dres pa glo bur du byung ba rdzas bden par ma grub pa 'bral rung bar/ shes nas byang phyogs dang bskyed rdzogs sogs thabs dang bcas sbyong ba/ tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar sgrib pa phyogs gcig dag phyogs gcig ma dag pa lam pa la gnas zhes byar rgyal bas gsungs/ rang bzhin la dri ma med pa'i khar glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa ni 'bras dus kyi sangs rgyas te/ sangs rgyas de sems can rnams kyi sems kyi gnas lugs yin pas/ de phyir 'gro kun chos dbyings bstod par gdod nas nyon yid ni kun brtags te bstan med sangs rgyas nyid/ zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las drug yid ni sgo lnga dang mtshungs te chos la dmigs mdor bstan pa dang rgyu phyi rol pa 'ga' zhig rgyu med par 'dod pa dang*/ rgyu de ma thag yid bzhin spang gnyen gyi shes pa g.yo ba'i cha tsam ste rnam shes thams cad skye 'gag gi gnas su 'gyur/ zhes so// 'bras kyi ngo bo nyid kyis grub par 'dod pa mi 'dra ba'i ched du sems snang rten 'brel tsam gyi rkyen spyir bstan pa ste dang po'o// ༈ // sems snang de'i ngor bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi spyir khams gsum dang bye mi'i lus ni 'grub pa'i tshul bshad pa ra bya ste rdo rje theg par gzhi lus sems gnyis las brten pa sems bcing ba la rten lus 'ching ba gnad che zhing*/ spyir lus ni sems kyi snang cha las grub pa yin kyang ci ltar grub pa shes dgos pas so/ / kun gzhi dang de 'khrid mkhan bdun yid la sngags skad du srog zhes bya ste srog 'dzin pa dang yang zhing g.yo ba min pa de rlung dang bcas pa ste lhan cig khams gsum skye bar sbyor ba na/

yid 'du byed bcas pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyis 'grub byed byas/ gzugs kyi 'du shes bzlog ste nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas so snyam pa la sogs bzhi/ yul du byas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'phen byed byas nas der skye ba ste ting nge 'dzin de rdzogs shing thob pa na sems ting nge 'dzin de nyid kyi rgyal tsam ste / rdul phran 'dus pa dang snang ba'i gzugs med ces bya bag chags dang bcas pa'i yid lus so// bsam gtan dang po gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa'i nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug la/ brten gang skye ba/ gzugs khams yin te 'dod khams las gyen du bskyod pa'i phyir 'dod sred ni/ nyon yid rags pa bcom pa sa 'dod khams la chags pa bral ba rdzus skyes so/ /thig le 'dzag pa khams gsum du skye ba'i rgyu yin na gzugs khams su pho mo'i dbang po med cing gzugs med na lus kyang med pas mi rigs zhe na/ de rnams la sems kyi zag pa nyon mongs yod par ma zad lus kyi zag pa 'byung ba'i khams 'pho ba yang yod de/ gzugs med bzhi pas rim du zad par nam mkha' 'i rlung me chu sa dang rlung 'og min sogs bzhir dang 'bras bu che ba sogs bzhir 1me chu 2 dang sa 3/ rlung me chu sa ste 'byung chung rnam par phye ba yi/ gya nom snang dang shin tu mthong gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i gzugs khams bcu drug dang gzugs med bzhi ste 'dod pa las gnas gzhan nyi shur gang skyes pa dang*/ de yi 'dzag pa 'byung chung bzhi tshan lnga tshad med dge sogs bzhir/ 'od chung sogs bzhir go rim bzhin/ 'byung chen gyi khams gzugs med bzhi nam mkha' gcig bu nas ni 'og min sogs la mkha' rlung gnyis 'bras bu che sogs la nam mkha' rlung me gsum tshad med dge sogs la nam mkha' rlung me chu lnga yi bar/ ldan pas ma rig pa kun gzhi tshogs bdun gyi rgyu rkyen dang ldan pa skye ba dang rga shi dang bcas/ dran pa nyer bzhag

gi bsdus don tu bstan to/ dge mi dge'i las stobs dang ldan zhing*/ bzhi 'od chung sogs mkha' rlung me chu sa dang*/ 'dod pa dang ldan pas 'dod khams rigs lha min lha'i nang du bsdus pa'i 'gro ba drug thams cad kyang*/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang ye shes kyi khams khu ba ltung ba'i bde ba ste khams drug dang ldan phra ba srin bu chung ngu dang rags pa lha la sogs pa thams cad/ sa chu me rlung shas che ba'i dbang las rdzus te sogs skye gnas bzhi ldan gling gsum gyi mi las gzhan dag rnams gang zhe na/ ngan song gsum ni dge sems skye ba dkon pas mi khom gnas yin pa'i phyir dang*/ lha dang lha min sgra mi snyan pa rnams kyi/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu spyod pa 'di phyir gnyen po bskyed dka' rgyu dman te/ gling gsum skyes pa'i khams drug ldan ni de lta ma yin pas/ mchog yin 'dod khams pa thams cad khams drug dang ldan kyang khyad par lho 'dzam gling 'dir legs skyes pa rnams la khams byang chub sems kyi yon tan skye bas so thar dang sngags kyi rten mchog yin cing 'di'i rten las byang chen thob nus pa dang bde 'gro dang ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i las thams cad stobs che ba dang dge ba dang mi dge ba bcu ka tshang bar spyod pas las kyi sa par rab tu grags zhes sdom 'byung las so/ / yul 'dir skye ba 'grub tshul gling gzhan gsum na tshe dang longs spyod nges pa can yin la yul 'dir 'phel 'grib yod pas ni/ dang por rdzus skyes gzugs khams 'od gsal gyi lha bzhin 'od dang lus dang tshe dpag tu med pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba'i zas dang ldan dge bcu'i stobs rdzogs pa'i rdzogs ldan no/ / de nas rim gyi sred dbang yin te sa mo zhag sogs kyi bri ste lus kyi las gsum spong bas gsum ldan gsod pa dang rku ba gnyis spong bas gnyis ldan las bcu ka tshang bar spyod pas rtsod ldan/ dus 'khor nang le las yang na tshe lus 'od dge bcu'i stobs bzhi rdzogs ldan/

gsung gi sgo zhes bya/ lag pa g.yas pa'i tshigs chen gsum la/ rlung gi khams kyis bskyed pa yi/ rtsa ni sum phyogs bzhir bdun bdun rtsa ba'i rtsa gnyis re ste cu sum cu gnas/ sor mo'i lnga po tshigs ni re re la// rtsa ni drug drug tu 'gyur te/ grangs ni gong dang mtshungs pa'o// de bzhin lag g.yon me yi khams// rkang pa g.yas pa chu khams te/ g.yon pa sa khams snga ma bzhin// de ltar tshigs chen gyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis bsgoms pa la// rtsa ni sum brgya drug cu'o// sor tshigs rtsa grangs de dang mnyam// nad ni bskyed par byed pa'i rtsa// gtsug tor rtsa bzhi dpral ba yi// bcu drug bad kan gyi nad skyed par byed cing nad gzhi smad du byed/ mgrin par rtsa ni sum cu gnyis// snying ga'i brgyad rnams mkhris pa 'i nad bskyed cing bad kan dang sdongs na smad dang rlung dang sdongs na stod nad/ lte ba'i drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ gsang ba'i phyi rol bcu drug gis/ rlung gi khams 'khrug cing nad gzhi stod du byed gsang ba yi/ nang rim bcu drug 'dus pa bskyed/ de ltar nad bskyed pa'i rtsa brgya dang lnga bcu drug / 'khor lo'i nang rim dang lte ba rnams na khams kyi dngas ma gnas pas nad bskyed pa mi rung ba'i phyir 'di rnams 'khor lo'i phyi rim ste khams kyi snyigs ma gnas pa rnams yin/ gzhan dag 'khor lo nyid du 'dod pa mi rigs so// stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis kyi// rnam dbye bshad brgyud rdo rje phreng ba las// stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni// zla ba dkar cha gtso cher 'bab pa rkyang ma'i rigs// stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni yod pa de pags par zug cing*/ nyi ma dmar cha gtso cher 'bab pa ro ma'i rigs// stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ sgra gcan rlung kho na rgyu dbu ma'i rigs su brjod/ stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis dbye tshul de yang lus la gnas pas na/ rtsa ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi po

las phye ba yin te // mi phyed ma nas yid bzang bar/ byed las kyi sgo nas bya ba byas zin pa'am ngo bo'i sgo nas rlung 'bab pa thim pa dang longs spyod byed bzhin pa'am khu ba 'bab pa bdag ma 'ongs par byed 'gyur ram khrag 'bab pa po 'am dag byed pa'ang zer yi/ dbye bas gsum gsum du phye ste bdun bcu gnyis/ re re'ang la'ang rtsa phran gyi 'khor ni stong stong ngo*// dper na sdong po gcig las ni/ yal ga lo 'dab gyes pa bzhin du nyer bzhi po las gyes pa yin zhing rtsa ba yan lag gi rlung rten rtsa bcu ro rkyang dang bcu gnyis ni der mi 'dus so/ /nyer bzhi po de las gyes pa'i phra ba'i rtsa rnams ni/ bye ba phrag ni phyed dang bzhi/ ba spu skyed par byed pa yin mi gtsang rdzas ni du mas gang*/ zhes dus 'khor la sa gsungs/ zhes 'byung ba ni bye ba phrag phyed bzhi'i nang du 'dus pa'i nges pa med do// 'di rnams khams kyi rim pa ni/ dga' bo mngal 'jug las / kun la rtsa ni brgyad khri gnas// der gnas srin bu brgyad khri dang*/ lte ba sa ste snying ga rlung*// mgrin pa me la spyi bo chu// gtsug tor nam mkha' gsang ba ni// ye shes bde ba'i rigs su gsungs// de bzhin du ba spu'i mthar thug bar/ khams drug gis ni rim par bskyed pas sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i khung bu thams cad kyang rin po che zur drug pa'i rnam par snang la rim pa yang ye shes khyab byed du btang nas khams lnga/ mkha' ye gnyis khyab byed du btang nas khams bzhi gsum thabs su byas pa'i rigs su'ang 'gyur ro// mkha' ye gcig tu byas/ rlung me gcig tu byas/ sa chu gcig tu byas pas g.yas g.yon dbu ma'i dbye ba las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum yin sems ye shes gsum shes rab chu rlung nam mkha' gsum thabs su byas pa'i rigs su'ang 'gyur ro// de ltar rtsa yi mtshan nyid bden rdzun dang bral ba chu zla lta bur

shes na/ lus la ril po dang rtag par lta ba log nas lus kyi gnas lugs rtogs pas gzugs kyi sku thob par 'gyur/ zab mo nang gi rnam par bshad pa las/ lus kyi rtsa rgyas par bstan pa ste gsum pa'o// ༈ //de nas rlung gi ngo bo gang yin pa ngos bzung ba dang*/ lte snying sogs gang du gnas dang so so'i byed las dang phyi nang du rgyu ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yas phyogs stobs dang g.yon phyogs stobs med rim pa dang*/ steng 'og bar gsum lus kun te 'jug pa'i sgo dang bzung 'byung rngub sogs thabs gzung 'dzin brgyad kyi skyon nyi zla'i phan yon rnams/ rim pa bzhin du 'dir bshad bya/ rlung ni ngag dang brjod pa sgra gdangs skad rnams skyed byed dang ngo bo nang gi dus sbyor dbugs kyi rgyu ba te chu srang lo dang bskal pa'i bar gyi rtsis gzhi yin/ sgra gdangs yi ge thams cad kyang skyed byed rlung 'di las skyes/ yi ge thams cad la las byung ba ltar rlung thams cad srog rlung las byung bas thog mar kun gzhi'i rnam shes la brten pa 'i bdun yid de'i 'khrul/ srog lung a yi sgra gdangs kyi rnam pa can grub bo/ / nam mkha' khams dang ye shes kyi khams kyi rang bzhin dbyer med yin/ de bzhin du 'khrul pa'i snang bar srog de las 'phros pa'i rtsa ba'i rlung bzhi ni / thur sel ye shes kyi rten byed pas sa khams l̥ yig ste// gyen rgyu me khams ṛ yin no// me mnyam rlung khams i zhes brjod/ khyab byed chu ste u ru 'gyur/ de nas srog las 'phros pa'i yan lag rlung lnga ni/ klu ni sas bskyed pas ye shes kyi rten nam mkha'i yi ge ā/ rus sbal khams rlung ste e ru bshad/ rtsangs pa me ste ā nyid yin/ lha sbyin chu khams o ru 'gyur/ al ni sa khams nor las rgyal/ 'khrang 'gyur gyi zhag dang po nas thog mar zla ba re re la/ rlung bcu po re re rim bskyed so so'i nus pa ma rdzogs par

da lta las kun byed/ nus pa sdud pa ni tshe lo brgya pa'i lo ni bcu bcur rlung re re sdud par bshad pas mthar srog rlung la sdud do// phung po dang lnga rlung sbyor ba na/ 'di ni ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ sems nyid 'od gsal ni ye shes rlung gis bskyed/ rang nyid rang gis ma rig pa mun pa kun gzhi 'i rnam shes kyi phung po ni nam mkha'i rlung ste nyon yid kyis bskyed pas nyon yid dang bcas/ 'du byed kyi phung po nyon yid dang de nyid ni g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid can yin pas rlung ste de'i mthu las blang dor gyi tshor ba med pa'i rlung gis bskyed / phung po ni rgyud sreg par byed pas rlung gis bskyed/ 'du shes kyi phung po ni yul la mtshan mar 'dzin cing sdud pas/ chu rlung gis bskyed pa yin la zhen pas grub pa'i gzugs phung ni sra ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pas sa/ de ltar rim pas phung po lnga dang sems nyid 'od gsal bskyed bya 'byung ba lnga'i rlung ye shes kyi rlung skyed byed gsungs te 'khor ba'i snang cha las tha dad yin kyang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbang du na phung khams rlung sems thams cad dbyer med gcig go// de dag gi snga ma phra ba rnams phyi ma rags pa'i skye byed kyang yin la sdud pa'i tshe yang rim thim nas rags pa rnams 'od gsal du 'jug go/

/ de ltar lus gnas las byed pa/ phyir ni rlung bcu lus rnams kun khyab kyang*// rtsa ba dbu ma ra gnas pa'i srog rlung nyon yid dang dbyer med ni/ lus kyi dbus gnas shing kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi rgyugs gsog pa'i rkyen byed pas rten par bzhin byed kyi kun gzhi nyon yid la tshur brten pa min/ gsang 'dus su gsungs pa'i mgon lnga las/ nam mkha'i mgon po zhes bya ba/ 'di'i cha shas dus sbyor thams cad kyi mthar 'dres nas rgyu zhing 'chi ba'i tshe na 'di nyid 'ba' zhig nyin zhag gcig yang dag rgyu/ byed las ni spyir ye shes la snang ba'i rnam rtog thams cad bskyed cing khyad par kun gzhi la dmigs nas da lta bdag tu 'dzin gzhan yang mi g.yeng ba'i dran rgyun chags pa skyed par byed/ gal lte gnas gzhan du log na 'bring brgyal smyo chen po 'chi bar byed/ las kyi rlung srog rlung nam mkha'i khams 'di dang ye shes kyi rlung mar dang 'o ma ltar 'dres par gnas/ kha dog nam mkha' lta bur bshad/ thur sel 'og tu rtsa gsum 'dus mdo man chad du gnas nas/ 'og 'gro bshang gci khu ba gsum gyi dngas snyigs 'byin dngas ma sdom byed/ rtsa dung can nang gnas shing bde ba'i khams kyi rten byed/ gnas gzhan du log na smad kyi nad skyed byed/ me mnyam snying ga'i shar mdun phyogs rtsa snar ma'i nang las byung*/ nad gzhi gsum dang 'grogs nas pho bar zug ste kha zas kyi dngas snyigs 'byed/ dngas ma lus kun tu khyer nas stobs bskyed snyigs ma 'dor bar byed gnas gzhan du log gyur na/ sbo 'khrog 'khru dang ma rungs kyi rtsa ser skya'i nang du sgyu zhing byed/ gyen rgyu ni snying ga'i mdun nas g.yas su nye ba me mtshams glang chen lce'i nang rtsa las byung*/ mgrin pa'i gnas su smra brjod dang ldag myang sogs las kun byed/ lus ngag glu dang lus kyi gar sogs rnams byed pa yin/ log na stod na phal cher byed/

khyab byed ni snying ga'i lho phyogs g.yas phyogs ro ma dang rgyal ba nub/ 'brel nas lus tshigs kun la gnas shing*/ lus kyi ldeg 'jog dang stobs byed de gnas gzhan du log pas/ yan lag zha rengs nad kun byed/ bden snying ga'i lho nub bral rtsa rgyal rgyab rtsa phyogs rlung nub byang rtsa a lam bu ṣa mtshams dang*/ byang g.yon rtsa i ṭa phyogs dbang byang ltar ldan rtsa ku hā rim pa ltar/ klu sogs yan lag rlung rgyu ba lnga ste/ klu yis gzugs 'dzin pa'i bdag rkyen dang lus sgeg chos rnams skyed par byed/ rus sbal sgra 'dzin rkang lag bskyod/ rtsangs pa dri 'dzin khro 'khrug byed/ lha sbyin ro 'dzin ni g.yon rkyang ma dang 'brel te glal ba byed/ nor rgyal phyogs gcig khams gyen du 'dren phyogs gcig gis reg 'dzin lus 'di la/ shi nas zhag gcig gi bar zhes kyang 'byung nas lus kyi rdul phra rab ma 'thor bar du gnas te rlung rgyu ba med kyang mi 'thor ba'i byed las tsam mo/ da lta snying ga na nang gi thun brgyad rang bzhin te/ rlung bcu gcig po 'di rnams gtso bo bstan pa yin re re'ang khams lnga'am drug gi bdag nyid rlung phyir 'gro na sdud rim nang du 'jug na bskyed rim 'byung ngo*/ /rgyu tshul lus kyi phyi nang gnyis yin te nang du rgyu tshul ni/ srog rlung sgra gcan rang bzhin ni/ dbu mar rgyal po lta bur gnas te rlung gzhan thams cad kyi rten dang 'phel 'grib kyi bdag po byed pa'i phyir/ ji ltar snying ga'i 'khor lo srog rlung nam mkha' dang ye shes 'dres pa'i rlung nas phyogs su 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ltar/ 'khor lo gzhan yang de bzhin du rgyu la rtsa mang na rlung grangs mang rtsa nyung na nyung te/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo bde dgyes gsang ba 'dus pa'i lugs la thabs shes so sor phye bas sum cu gnyis/ dus 'khor nas thabs shes dril bas zla ba'i rkang pa dang mtshungs pa'i/

rlung rgyu de phyir bcu drug bshad des na lus la gnas pa'i tshe phyi'i bcu drug na khrag gtso bor rgyu nang rtsa bcu drug na zla rkang dang mtshungs par rlung dang byang sems dkar cha lhag par rgyu bas nang gi bcu drug zla rkang dang sbyor ba yin/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg gi yon tan lnga pa'i rlung rgyu sa gsum dang gzugs sgra ro reg chu bzhi sa'i rtsa gcig /dpral ba'i dkyil du ba'i rtsa 'phel ba dang ltag dkyil du 'gribs te rtsa gnyis ni stong pa'i rang bzhin te nam mkha' ye shes/ gzhan dag bcu bzhi dpral ba'i dkyil nas rim pa ltar/ sgra ro reg gsum me gnyis sgra reg sgra gcig nam mkha' ni rtsa re re ste rtsa bdun la 'byung ba lnga'i rlung rim bzhin rgyu brgyad pa ni yon tan gang yang med pa ltag pa'i rtsa'o// phyi ma'i rtsa bdun la pas zhes rim pa bzlog /brgyad pa ni bde ba ye shes kyi chas gang ba de dpral ba'i dkyil rtsa'o/ / de dag lnga dang bzhi sogs yon tan rim pa yis phye ba yin/ dbyug dgu chu tshod nyer brgyad stong pa chu tshod bzhi/ spyir bsdoms pa ni zhag gcig gi chu tshod sum cu gnyis dang*/ stong pa'i chu tshod gnyis re la yud tsam rer byas pa'i yud tsam sum cu'i bdag nyid dag sbyor yin par brjod/ mgrin par rtsa ni bcu drug po/ dus 'khor las thabs shes tha dad du dbye bas rtsa sum cu gnyis/ de la bzhir ni ye shes nam mkha'i rlung stong pa rgyu ba dbu ma'i rigs/ gzhan dag nyer brgyad po phyogs bzhi bdun bdun du/ rgyu skar longs spyod dang mtshungs rgyu/ gzhan bde dgyes gsang 'dus nas thabs shes bsdoms pas thun brgyad la phyed mar byas pa'i 'pho ba bcu drug bshad/ lte bar rtsa ni drug cu bzhi/ khyim gyi dbye bas phye bas na bcu gnyis / lnga de re re la lnga lngar gyes pas tshan bcu gnyis drug cu ste/ dbyug gu drug cu'i dag sbyor bdag nyid g.yas g.yon rnams pa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rim pa 'byung ba sdud rim g.yon phyogs rnams sa mkha' rlung me chu sa bskyed rim gyi rlung rgyu'o

do/ / rtsa ba'i rtsa bzhi bzhi ni stong pa nam mkha' dang ye shes kyi cha ro rkyang nas nang du dbu mar rgyu/ kun 'khor lo drug por rgyu ba'i rlung gcig pu la rtsa lngar yod pa'i dbus su nam mkha'i rlung phyogs bzhir 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba sogs so kyang mdun phyogs thams cad rlung*/ g.yas me g.yon chu rgyab nub bam 'og phyogs sa/ mtshams rnams su'ang shar lho rlung nas nub byang sa dang bcas pa rags pa yin khyim bcu gnyis po'i lug khyim/ de bzhin tshigs chen bcu gnyis kyi/ 'khor lo'i rtsa sum cu'i nang du rlung rgyu ba sum cu ste/ kun la sum brgya drug cu'i srog ste rlung dang ldan*/ nying lag rnams la'ang rlung grangs de dang mtshungs pa yin/ de nas 'khor lo rgyu tshul bshad nas stong phrag nyi shu bzhir/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung kho na 'gro ba dbu ma'i rigs dang bdag nyid gsungs/ rlung dang lhan cig dkar dmar cha rgyu ba rkyang ma'i rigs dang dmar cha rgyu ba ro ma'i rigs gyis phye de dang mnyam/ ste stong phrag nyer bzhi re'o// bsdoms pas rtsa stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis su de rnams/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung*/ de ltar nang nas rgyu zhing dbugs dbyungs rngub re re yang ba spu'i mthar thug par 'gro bar 'gyur/ dus 'chi'i dbang du byas na/ gang tshe lte ba'i lug sogs rtsa gcig tu/ rlung 'gags de tshe phyogs kun 'dra bar de'i cha shas kyi rlung 'gag nang gi rlung 'di la dbye ba dpag med kyang*/ phyi rol rtsis dang mtshungs pa/ te phyir lo gcig nang du zhag gcig dang zla ba bcu gnyis dang 'pho bcu gnyis lo gcig gi chu tshod dang zhag gcig gi dbugs grangs la ye rlung drug brgya don lnga ni phyir lo gcig la zhag bcu gcig dang bzhi cha lhag par snang ba lta bu/ yin/ de nas phyi rol rgyu ba bshad// ba spu dbang po'i sgo kun nas/ rgyu yang khyad par 'jug pa'i sgo

lte ba nas/ rtsa chen ro rkyang gnyis brgyud sna bug tu// g.yas pa nyi ma dug tshe'i nus pa zad par byed pa sdud rim gi rlung khug pa/ g.yon pa zla ba bdud rtsi bskyed rim ste/ thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin no// zhag re bzhin du de yi rlung*/ khri dang bzhi brgya drug cu gnyis/ dbugs gcig gi phyed bcas re dang tshan pa gnyis nyi zla'i rlung du brjod/ de gnyis dbus nas rgyu ba'i rlung khug pa/ drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ni/ sgra gcan mkha' dang dbu ma la 'jug pa ye shes kyi/ rlung ste gnyis su med pa thugs/ de la ngo bo'i dbye ba yis/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sa sogs lnga yi bdag nyid do// rlung rgyu ba'i thog ma ni skye dus ma dang 'brel ba'i rlung gi gnas/ lte thag de chad cing de nas bu'i snar rgyu bas de karka ṭa yi khyim du bshad/ de nyi la karka ṭa'i khyim du skyes pa dang sbyar ro// da ni nang gi dus sbyor bshad par bya/ rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa'i rlung bcu/ lus kyi rtsa nyer bzhi kun 'khor lo'i rtsa rnams so rim brgyud de// lte bar srog gi nus pa bskyed de de nas snar rgyu'o/ /glang karka ṭa bu mo'i sdig pa chu srin nya mnyam dang mi mnyam lug 'khrig pa seng ge srang gzhu bum pa khyim bcu gnyis te 'pho chen / re mos mnyam pa la g.yas dang mi mnyam pa la g.yon du rlung 'byung bas phyir/ nyi ma lho bgrod dang po la karka ṭa'i khyim du zhugs nas zla ba drug nyin thung ba ltar sna bug g.yas nas 'byung ba'i rlung rnams nyi ma'i rlung*/ sa chu me rlung mkha' ste 'byung ba sdud cing zad par byed pa rim bzhin 'pho chung lnga rgyu sum 'pho chung lnga po re re la rlung khug brgya drug cu drug cu ste/ kun la bsdoms pas 'pho chen gcig la rlung khug stong dang brgyad brgya'o// de 'og spyir byang bgrod chu srin sogs ltar g.yon byang bgrod la/ nas zla ba'i rlung*/

nam mkha' rlung me chu sa yi/ 'byung ba bskyed pa'i rim pas grangs ni gong dang mtshungs 'pho chung re la sum brgya drug cu 'pho chen re la stong dang brgyad brgya'o// de ltar 'pho ba chen bcu gnyis la stong brgyad brgya ba tshan pa bcu gnyis yod pas/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ste/ 'di nang de la ye shes rlung khug tu yod pa bshad pa/ drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga yod pa yin/ 'pho ba chen po re re ye rlung rlung khug lnga bcu drug sa rlung khug gcig la so gnyis su bgos pa'i bzhi cha ste brgya/ dbyug gu 'pho chung rer ye rlung bcu gcig dang bzhi cha ste/ mdor na dbugs gcig so gnyis cha ye rlung yin pa de/ bsags pas de ltar dbugs so gnyis na ye rlung dbugs khug gcig tu gyur pa yin/ sog 'grel la sa/ dbugs khug so gnyis song nas ye rlung dbugs khug gcig /de bzhin du chu srang so gnyis nas ye rlung chu srang gcig /chu tshod so gnyis nas chu tshod gcig zhag sngo gnyis nas zhag gcig /zla ba so gnyis nas zla gcig /lo so gnyis nas lo gcig /des na lo go drug 'phel 'grib med pa'i lo dang go bdun nas ye rlung lo gsum/ de rjes lo gsum la ye rlung phyogs gsum zhes bshad/ ye rlung dbugs khug gcig po de yang phyed ni phyir rgyu la/ ro rkyang nas rtsa ba'i rtsa bzhi brgyud de phyed ni dbu mar rgyu bas tshe'i nus pa 'phel/ phyir nyi zla sogs 'di ni gza' kun rkang pa dang mtshungs te nang du sna bug gnyis nas 'a byung ba sogs rlung thams cad dbu ma'i cha shas 'di las 'byung bas so ste/ 'di ni byed las lhag pa phyir 'gro 'phel bas dbu ma'i dus 'chi ltas yin/ phyir mi 'gro bar nang du zin na 'chi med rdo rje'i lus 'grub/ lo brgya'i ye rlung gi rgyu ba dbugs drug la chu srang sogs bsdoms pa na/ ye rlung lo gsum zla ba phyed dang gnyis te phyogs gsum longs/

khyim zhag tshes zhag sogs dbyar nyi ldog nas dbyar nyi ldog bar lo gcig la tshes zhag sum brgya drug cus ma snyoms nas tshes zhag gcig bsnan dgos byung*/ bcu gcig pa bsdoms pas lo gnyis dang zla ba phyed dgu na zla lhag 'byung ste shol dang 'phel 'grib rnams/ 'di don rtogs pas ma nor 'char phyi nang chos mtshungs/ rgyu rim kha dog stobs yon tan/ dang po rgyu rim ni sna yi ka ba gnyis la brdabs te rgyu ba ni/ sna bug gi byang ste g.yas g.yon gnyis ka'i chu rlung yin la/ phyi rol gshog pa gnyis nas rgyu ba ni me ru 'dod/ steng gnyis rlung ste 'og gnyis mchu la brten pa sa/ dbus ni nam mkha' ye shes kyi khams yin/ kha dog sa chu me rlung mkha'/ ser dkar dmar nag sngo bar 'dod/ rlung lnga po 'di dag stobs dang ldan mi ldan ni g.yas pa rnams drag gza' lnga ste/ l̥̄ spen sa rlung sa ū phur chu bu bkra me shis rlung ī nyi ma dus me ā nam mkha'/ sa sogs rim pas stobs med g.yon pa rnams zhi gza' lnga ste/ a sgra mkha' gcan zla rlung i ba gza' ṛ lhag me dang*/ u pa sangs chu mjug l̥ ring sa mkha' rim stobs ldan bzhin phyi'i dus sbyor ji lta ba bzhin nang du 'char ro/ nang gi phung po khams sogs de 'i nus pa dang de la snang ba'i phyi rol gyi 'byung ba da nga gza' skar sogs nus pa'i yon tan mthun pa 'i rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/ nam mkha'i rlung bsad gso'i las kun sogs las thams cad 'grub/ rlung gis bsgrub bya yul gzhan du bskrad dang bsad pa ste/ dbang dang dgug pa me yis byed/ chus ni nad gdon sogs zhi dang tshe bsod sogs rgyas pa'o// bsgrub bya'i sgo gsum rengs dang rmongs pa sa yi las/ ye shes las ni thams cad pa/ ye rlung rgyu ba'i dus ni 'pho chen g.yas g.yon gyi thun mtshams sna bug gnyis su mnyam du rgyu dus so// sna bug gnyis nas rlung

phyi rol du 'gro ba'i tshes sa rlung ni sor bcu gnyis/ bcu gsum chu bcu bzhi me bco lnga rlung mkha' bcu drug bar/ yon tan chung bas yang ba'i dbang gis rim bzhin phyi ring ba'i tshe nang du thung ngur 'gyur ro ye rlung yang g.yon nas g.yas par 'pho mtshams su sa rlung dang g.yas nas g.yon par 'pho mtshams su mkha' rlung dang ring thung mnyam ring phyi ma rnams/ rten 'brel rtsis dang dbyangs sbyar ba zhib par/ kho bos rtsis kun bsdus par bshad/ g.yon nas rgyu ba myur 'grub cing*/ g.yas phyogs yid 'grub ngan pa ste/ dbu mar bar snyoms las rnams 'gyangs/ rlung gi sgyu tshul/ 'di ni rdo rje phreng ba las/ pha rol g.yul du zhugs pas rang la dri ba'i tshe/ g.yas su dus me dang 'grig na 'chi bar ston/ nyi mas yan lag nyams/ bkra shis la gnad/ phur bur nyen tshe/ spen par yun ring rtsod/ nad pa rnams kyis dri na rim par/ 'chi dang nyon mongs rma dod dang*/ bcos 'tsho nad yun ring bar 'gyur/ yul gyi gtad mo bag ma dang*/ zhi dang rgyas pa'i las rnams kun/ 'di dag bzang ba ma yin te/ g.yon du sgra gcan dang mgrig na dgra phar 'joms/ zla bar yan lag nyams par byed/ gza' mag la rmas/ pa sangs nor thob/ 'jug ring la dgra dbang du 'gyur/ nad pa rnams ni 'tsho ba dang*/ dga' ston 'jig rten bya ba yid/ zhi dang rgyas kun myur 'grub byed/ sgra gcan ma gtogs gzhan rnams dag /drag po'i las la stobs ldan min/ gzhan yang rang nyid mnyam gzhag dus/ dus min phyin ci log 'pho na/ g.yon gyi phyogs rnams sngar ltar bzang*/ nor dang zas dang longs spyod thob// g.yas phyogs dus min 'pho ba ngan// nad dang nor nyams 'jig skrag dang*// gtam ngan thos par 'gyur ba'i rtags/

1$1000240 grangs thim nas kyang*/ yun ring phyin log rgyu/ 'chi ba'i ltas su ston par byed// de sogs dpag tu med pa yin/ 'chi bzlog ni/ thog mar lus kyi ngal dub bsal// rtsa dag pa yi sbyor ba sgoms// rkang pa skyil krung lus srang nas// lag gnyis mchan khur 'phar rtsa bsdams/ g.yas nas 'chi rtags rgyu na lag pa g.yon pas g.yas kyi 'phar rtsa bsdam/ steng 'og bar gsum mnyam bcings nas// lus kun rlung gis dgang bar bya// zhag bdun gyi ni 'chi ba 'phrog / sna yi bu ga las rlung lnga byung zhing*/ rlung lnga po de yang steng du yang dag rgyu/ g.yon pa nas rgyu ba g.yas pa nas rgyu ba dang gnyis ka nas drag tu rgyu ba dang*/ gnyis ka nas dal bar rgyu ba rnam pa bzhi la mgon po bzhir bshad de/ sna bug g.yas pa nas ni 'byung ba'i khams/ me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ kha dog dmar po bzang po 'di/ pad+ma'i mgon po rgyu bas de'i tshe āḥ'i bzlas pa bya ba'o// sna bug g.yon pa nas ni 'byung ba'i khams// rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang 'dres pa/ kha dog ljang ser dag tu snang ba ste// las kyi mgon po rgyu bas de'i tshe oṃ bzlas pa ba'o bya ba'o// sna bug gnyis ka nas ni drag por 'byung ba'i khams/ gser mdog dbang chen nyid/ rin chen mgon po rgyu yin pas 'og gi sna rtse gsum 'dus su sems gtad cing bde chen ye shes rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba'o// dal zhing sna bug gcig nas rgyu ba med med par gnyis ka nas 'byung pa'i khams/ dag pa'i shel ltar snang ba ni/ 'di ni chu yi dkyil 'khor te/ rdo rje'i mgon po rgyu bas de'i tshe hūṃ bzlas pa ba'o// bzlas pa ma yin pa'i sa la sogs pa'i khams kun nas ni yang dag 'byung zhing thams cad kyi khyab byed du gnas pa/ rten lus dang brten pas sems sam rten 'od gsal dang brten pa kun gzhi'i bzhon par gzung ba ni/ nam mkha'i mgon po rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin te/

cha shas dus sbyor thams cad dang 'dres nas rgyu zhing 'di nyid 'ba' zhig nyin zhag gcig 'chi ba'i mthar ni 'byung bar mun pa chen zad byed ces bya 'gyur/ sa chu me rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhi po de dag ni/ dbyung ba oṃ rngub pa āḥganas pa hūṃ bde ba chen por ro mnyam par bya ba'i rdo rje bzhi dang sbyar nas mnyam par bzhag pas rtag tu zlos/ zhes rdor bzlas bzhir nges so// zhes gsungs don ni lam dus su rnal 'byor pas bzlas pa bya ba'i tshe rlung bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi yi/ dag pa sbyar bas bstan te gong ma dus 'khor las gzhi'i dbang du byas nas nyi khri chig stong drug brgya gsungs pa dang*/ 'gal ba'i the tshom bskyed mi bya ste de gnyis gnas skabs mi gcig pas so// snga ma de ltar rlung gzhan yang bzlas pa'i tshul ni spyi bo nas rlung mgrin pa nas me snying ga nas chu lte ba nas sa rlung rim pas phyi rol du sor nyi shu bco brgyad bcu drug bcu gnyis rgyu bas de dang mtshungs par 'khor lo bzhi'i sna rtser te lte bar rlung ni/ kha dog lnga pa'i thig le lnga'i rnam par bsgom/ rdo rje'i sngags bzlas pa nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yi grangs kyis ni/ nyin mtshan rtag tu zlos zhes bshad/ bla ma rnams kyi man ngag las 'byung ba ltar me rlung dang rlung gi rlung gnyis 'jug sgo steng nas sna bug gnyis/ chu rlung kha dang sa rlung ni 'og tu lam gsum dang*/ ma ning ngam nam mkha'i rlung lus kun nas 'jug pa yin te rnam pa bzhi/ gzung thabs lus gnad bcas sems rnal du bzhag ste dbugs/ dbyung rngub gcig nas chu srang chu tshod sogs kyi bar bgrang ba gnas ldog dang ni rtsa gnas thams cad du rlung lus kyi mthar thug par 'gro ba dang ldog pa la dmigs pa'o/ /de ni dag pa bgrang zhing rtsi ba gzung thabs dang po'o ba ste/ gzung thabs gnyis pa rlung sems gnyis ka ma bcos 'jug pa mi rtog rgya yan bcing ba ni/

zhi gnas skyed par byed pa yin te sor sdud dang lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs kyi nyams len no// gzung thabs gsum ni kha dog dbyibs la rnam par sbyangs/ snying gar kun gzhi'i zla ba'i dbyibs su sgom pa la gzhan gyi sems dang bsres pas gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes rlung so so'i kha dog la dmigs nas zad par 'byung ba'i rgyu/ gzung thabs bzhi pa bum can ni steng srog rtsol 'og thur sel bar rlung de gnyis ro mnyam du bcing ba gsum gyis rtsa ba'i rlung gzung ba dang*/ seng ge rnam grol gyi yan lag gi rlung bzung ba bcas pas zhi rgyas sogs las kun byed/ rlung zin pa'i phan yon du ba smig rgyu mkha' snang sgron ma 'bar ba ste mtshan rtags lnga/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ sgra gcan/ mchog gi cha glog /thig le/ de nas las kyi dbu ma'i byed pa bcings pa las rtags can bcu gcig pa sna tshogs gzugs te nyin rtags drug dang rtags bcu 'grel chen las du ba smin rgyu me khyer mar me 'bar ba/ zla nyi sgra gcan cha shas thig le zhes gsungs pa rnam pa brgyad yin te/ rtags can gcig steng du nyi zla sgra gcan gtso bo gsum la brten pa'i rlung ni srog nyi ma'i rang bzhin yin la/ de gsum gyi rlung zin pas phan yon 'og tu 'byung ste skyang mas 'dod chags ro mas zhe sdang dbu mas gti mug ste dug gsum rnam rtog 'joms shing spong pa dang*/ rkyang ro dbu gsum gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnam gsum thob byed yin/ de ni srog nyi ma'i yon tan dug gsum gyi gzung 'dzin dag par gsungs/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi/ yul lnga dbang byed pa'i yon tan steng du 'byung ba ni 'og gi rtsa gsum thur sel zla ba'i rang bzhin la brten pa'i zla ba'i rlung zin pas yin te/ de ni sgo lnga'i gzung 'dzin dag pa dang ye shes lnga thob par byed la/ rlung zin pa'i gnas skabs kyi yon tan sa brtan dang

chus snum dang mes gsal skrag mdangs dang rlung gis mgyogs/ nam mkhas dbang po dag cing shes rab che ldan pa/ sa sogs lus la yon tan bla ma te pu pas bshad/ rlung gi phra ba'i gzugs kyi sa su/ shes te yang dag 'dres te gnas/ mdor na rlung ni rtog pa dang dbyer med ste/ yul la g.yo dang phra ba dang gzhan du skyod byed par mtshan nyid mtshungs par phyir/ de dag gi rang bzhin sems kyi de bzhin nyid dag cing gsal la mi rtog pa de'i/ ngo bo ni ye shes rlung chen po/ de dang rgyu mthun pa'i lam dus su gnyen po ye shes rlung chen gang yin na ni/ bdag med pa la med par rtogs pa sogs yang dag rtog pa'i yid kyi 'du byed la bshad/ kun gzhi la gnas pa'i yang dag min rtog nyon yid ni/ bdag tu rtog pa sogs gti mug bskyed pa'i sgra gcan bdun pa'i rlung du bshad/ 'du byed bdun yid kyi mthu las ye shes rang gi snang cha rang dang dbyer med 'od lnga las/ gzhan rang las du rtog pa ni gzung ba dang chags pa'i rlung gzhan snang zhes bya ste dga' ba'i 'dod chags g.yo bas so/ /de la rten na rnam shes kyi yul la blang dor dpyod pa'i rlung*/ 'dzin pa bdag rtog zhe sdang rlung ste dug gsum des bskyed nas/ de ltar khams gsum po dug gsum gyi rlung gi 'du byed ces/ gsungs pas 'khor 'das kyi skyon dang yon tan kun/ rlung dang rtog pa dbyer med la rten de ltar rtogs byas nas/ rlung gi sbyor ba shes shing gnad bcings pas pha rol 'gro/ ma shes na rlung gis 'khor bar 'khor byed la/ 'khor ba de gtsor byed pa'ang rlung gis 'grub par 'gyur/ phyi nang du rgyu ba'i rlung ming byed las kun dang rtog pa dbyer med la rgyal bas mdo rgyud las gsungs pa/ le'u gnyis pa dang bzhi pa 'dir ni nyams len la 'kho ba rnams bsdus te bstan pa yin/ zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las rlung gi rgyu tshul bstan pa ste bzhi pa'o//

༈༈༈༈ //de ltar rtsa dang rlung bstan nas/ thig le gnas dang rgyu tshul ni/ rtsa ba spros bral gzhi'i rang bzhin thig le dang*/ 'khrul pa ma gzhi'i gnas skabs rig thig le dang*/ de yi gnyen po lam gyi gnas skabs thig le dang*/ 1$1000240 dang po rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ de yang ngo bo stong pa spros bral chos sku ste/ rnam pa rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs/ 'gag pa med thugs rje rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba cir yang 'grub pa'i sprul sku/ de gsum yod pa'i rtags ni da lta so skye la yang mtshon du yod pa yang*/ thams cad rigs pas dpyad pas stong par snang ba dang shes pa skad cig ma'i rang bzhor rig gi ngo bo dang*/ klu dang sgom pas dbyings rig rtags bcu 'char ba rang bzhin dang*/ tshogs drug gi yul snang nus pa 'gag med 'byin pa thugs rje chen po mtshon ste/ gsum po bslu med yul gyi rtags te/ yul can gyi ye shes ni der 'brel shes pa 'i rang ngo 'a ོ/ /ye shes de ni rtog bral ma 'khrul ba 'i rnal 'byor/ rtsa ba spros bral thig le yin/ rgyas par mdo rgyud kun las la lar drang don la lar nges don la lar sbas la lar gsal bar gsungs/ 'khrul pa ma rig theg le ni/ spros bral ma rig pa dang des las 'du byed pa dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes gos pa las/ kun tu brtags pa'i tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes te ming bzhi 'i phung po las bsgyur ba 'i lam/ brtags pa sngags kyi lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzlas pa sogs la thig le dang*/ rkyen gsum la brten pa'i gzhan dbang yid kyi yul la 'jug pa'i nus pa la ni rlung yin/ rlung de 'ching ba la gi thig le zhes su bshad/ shes pa'i yul snang gzugs kyi phung po las byung ba'i la/ khams lnga 'di rang bzhin gyi dkar dmar la rdzas kyi thig le zhes/ rgyal bas rnal 'byor rgyud du bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar gsung*/ de la rdzas kyi thig le la/

mngal du nying mtshams sbyar nas thig le grub pa la phyi nang gnyis te nang gi don/ dang po skye bar sbyor ba'i tshe/ bar do'i shes pa'i ngo bo de/ pha ma'i rkyen las zhen pa yis/ khams 'gyur gong du bstan pa bzhin/ da lta gnas tshe rnam shes dang ye shes dngas snyigs byas pa dang de gnyis so so'i phra rags la dngas snyigs su byas pa las phyi ma'i dbang du byas dngas snyigs gnyis/ ye rlung sems 'od gsal snying po dngas ma sngar bstan la/ rdzas thig le'i dngas ma dkar dmar gnyis/ dkar cha dbu ma'i yar sna na/ haṃ gi rnam pa'i rang bzhin yungs dkar tsam/ chu'i khams yin pas dkar la snum pa shel dang mtshungs/ sgyu pha las khams sogs thob pa kun gyi mchog he ru ka'i rang bzhin/ dmar cha lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus pa na/ dmar gsal rgod ma'i me 'dra ba/ rnam pa a thung rdo rje phag mo'i rang bzhin te/ bde mchog tu dkar cha la dpyid dang dmar cha la thig le zhes kyang bshad/ de gnyis la kun gzhi srog rlung brten/ rdo rje gdan la byang chub snying po'i gzhir brjod pa bzhin zung 'jug mngon du byed pa'i byang chub snying po'i ngo bo zhes/ sdom 'byung rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsung*/ de brten snyigs kyang nang sems dngas snyigs gnyis yod pa'i/ dmar cha 'i dngas ma ni mes bskyed cing me'i rang bzhin lus kyi drod bskyed pa gyen 'gro la/ dkar po chu'i mtshan nyid kyis spyi bo nas 'og 'gro/ snyigs ma ni dang po gzhi dus kyi sbyin sreg rgyus bskyed la/ phyi rol kha zas kyi dngos po rnams/ sreg rdzas lag pa dgang blugs te/ khar ni thab khung phung po'i khams skye mched ni gdod nas lha ste 'das pa la mchod/ dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i pho bar las byed 'dzin pa'i lha zhal gsum ste/ gsum ni me mnyam rlung dag bad kan ni/ myags byed mkhris pa mdog 'gyur gsum/ dang pos bsreg gnyis pas gzhus gsum pas sbyangs nas de yi dngas/

mchin par rtsa chen mkhyen bu dang bzhi la brgyud/ khrag chen gyur nas rtsa kun 'gro/ khrag gis dngas mas sha bskyed/ de'i dngas ma de las tshil/ de'i dngas rus pa de'i dngas rkang dang de'i dngas khu ba ste nang gi skye ba bdun pa'o/ / lus zungs dngas ma bdun zhes bya dus 'khor las rtsa rgyus rkang gsum khu ba las byung*/ pho ba'i snyigs las bska sla gnyis/ bska ba bshang ba rgyu mar brgyud nas 'gro/ sla gci ba ba rgyu sgrog nas song nas/ khrag sha pags pa gsum sdul las byung ste mdzod drug go /snga ma chu rlung nam mkha'/ phyi ma sa me ye shes/ lgangs pa nas ni 'bab par byed/ khrag snyigs mchin pa dang 'brel ba las mkhris pa ni/ bskyed nas de snyigs 'og tu 'gro/ mkhris pa'i snyigs mas ni chu'i ku ya dang*/ dri chen gyi dri dang ser po byed/ sha yi snyigs ma pags pa dang dri ma/ tshil snyigs rmen bur 'gyur ba ste/ rus snyigs so dang sen mo chu rgyus rnams yin/ rkang snyigs sbubs kyi mchil snabs bshad/ khu ba'i snyigs ma dung can nas 'og tu 'bab/ dngas mas stobs dang kha dog byed/ 'di ni khams dngas snyigs spyi tsam bshad pa yin/ rgyas bshad khams ni sum cu drug snying ga'i yan lag rlung rten rtsa bzhir gnas pa'i thig le bzhi ni mig sogs rnam par shes pa dang*/ 'brel ba nang gi mchod pa bzhi zhes bya/ bdud bral nas byung khams dkar cha de ni/ steng 'gro zhing lce chung dbus su zag cing*/ rgyu des khams lugs ldog yin pas zla ba'i nag phyogs dang mthun bshad/ thig le 'di yang reg bya'i phyogs gcig 'dzin/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang 'brel ba 'di thig le'i byed las kyang*/ sngar bshad pa dang mthun zhing 'dir yang thig le lnga dang dbu ma'i cha/ steng du rtsa dang rlung gsum la brten pa'i srog nyi ma'i chos can nyi ma'i thig le gcig 'og phyogs su/ dri chu khu ba rnams gsum gyi rtsa rlung la brten pa'i thur sel zla ba'i thig le gcig ste dngas ma bcu gnyis yang na rtsa ba yan lag bcu ro rkyang gnyis bcu gnyis brten/

khyad par mar sna dung can ma/ bco lnga cha yi thig le ni/ gang ba bde ba skye ba'i rtsa/ de nor bu'i rna bar 'brel zhing bud med la rtsa de ro mas dang 'brel bas khrag gi khams 'dzin pas/ skyes pa bu med khyad par des byed/ dbang gnyis ka'i mchog skyed par byed pa'o/ 'di ni kha sbyor thig le las/ phyogs bzhi 'dab ma'i rtsa ba'i rtsa la gnas pa 'i/ 'byung ba bzhi'i thig le la ba che rnams mar me'i sgron ma lnga'i dngos/ mtshams rtsar kyi bzhi dang snying ga'i 'og phyogs kyi ni bdud rtsi lnga 'bab gnas/ mtshams rtsa de brten mchod pa bzhi zhes bshad/ 'dir ni lus kyi snying dbus su/ rtsa lnga po ni yang dag gnas/ sku gsung thugs kyi

ta gcig ni yid bzangs te/ rtag tu gong du kha lud sna chu 'bab pa yin sa bcu pa/ bde med phyir khu ba 'dor nang du dur khrod ro bdag po med pa ltar rnam rtog spong ba la'ang bshad de nye ba 'o// de ltar khams ni nyi shu bzhi yang rtsa nyer bzhi'i dbye ba ltar/ thim pa 'jig pa snyigs mar gyur pa ste/ longs spyod gnas dngas ma dkar cha yin/ de skyed par byed pa'i bdag po rtsa ba skye ba rlung khrag 'dres/ nyer bzhi pa re re'ang stong phrag gsum gsum ste/ rlung dang dkar dmar gsum bdag nyid/ ba spu mthar thug kun tu khyab/ khyad par dngas ma zla ba ni/ spyi bo nas ni gcu drug brgyud nas rtsa/ sa chu me rlung khams bzhi la nang gses bcu drug ldan pa mgrin par 'bab/ bcu drug phyed phyed de'i phyed brgyad snying ga de'i phyed gzhi lte ba de na gcig tu gyur pa'i thig le can/ lte ba nas me la gcig gyur nas tu 'bab pas na/ dung can bco lnga gang nas cha bcu drug pa'i ngo bor gnas mthar 'ching mi nus pa la ni 'dzag par byed 'dis ni sems can kun la dug gsum bskyed de/ 'di la brten nas lus kyi tshig rnams su'ang dkar cha'i 'pho ba 'byung ste/ rtsa rgyud kyi lugs skyes pa'i dbang du byas na/ yar ngo'i tshes gcig la rkang pa g.yon pa'i sor mo'i tshigs dang po la a'o// gnyis pa la gnyis par i/ gsum pa la gsum par ṛ/ bzhi pa la lung bur u/ lnga pa la pus mor l̥/ drug pa la brla'i mtshams su a/ bdun pa la lag g.yon sor tshigs dang por e/ brgyad par gnyis par ar// dgu pa la gsum par o// bcu par lag pa'i mkhrig mar al// bcu gcig par gru ma ha// bcu gnyis par dpung par ya// bcu gsum par mgrin g.yon du ra// bcu bzhi par mtshogs mer wa/ bco lnga par spyi bor la/ bcu drug par tshangs phug dang lus spyi ru aṃ/ nag phyogs kyi tshes gcig sogs la yi ge rnams ring por g.yas phyogs spyi bo nas rkang sor bar lugs bzlog ste bcu drug pa la rkang mthil gnyis dang lus spyi āḥ

kun tu 'bod pa ste mchan 'byung ba'i tshul bstan pa ste brgyad pa'o// ༈ //de nas 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad sems dag ma dag gi snang bar sngar bstan kyi/ sbyang gzhi lha sgom pa'i skabs ltar sbyong byed gsungs pa yi/ rgyu mtshan nges pa 'dir ni bstan par bya/ sems can khams rdo rje theg pa 'dir 'bras bu lam du byed pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang dbyer med pa'i ni sangs rgyas kyi chos dbyings bstod par yang*/ de dag kun gyi nyon mongs zlog /khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ zhes snying po bstan par/ snying po rang bzhin dri ma med mod 'on kyang de'i gnas tshul bden gnyis dbyer med pa rtogs pas 'khrul 'khor ldan/ bden gnyis 'di ni ye shes rdo rje rgyud kun las btus pa ru/ kun rdzob mi bden pa'i sgra gzung ba dang 'dzin pas kun brtags pa'i rgyu 'bras spang thob 'khor 'das dus gsum bya byed sogs snang ba ste/ 'o na de'i bden pa ni chu zla lta med bzhin du snang ba bu'o// don dam ni dag pa'i sems sangs rgyas kyi snying po ste / chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid/ rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no stong nyid bco brgyad de/ bden pa gnyis po dang yang de nyid gzhan gcig dang tha dad sogs gnyis chos gnyis med ye shes zung 'jug brjod/ don dam rtogs pa'i thabs su tha snyad dgos pas don dam de rtog par byed pa'i yang dag pa'i rtog pas bskyed yang dag pa'i lta ba zung 'jug mtha' bral chen po/ de ni gnyen po 'khor 'das sbyong byed yin par bshad/ snying po dang dri ma ma phye ba sbyang gzhi yin la dri ma ni sbyang bya yin des na dri bcas yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi sku gsung thugs ye shes lnga sogs sbyang gzhi'i grangs bzhin chos kun bstan/ tshangs sogs 'di'i tshul ma rtogs pa'i log rtog ni grub mtha' thams cad kyang*/ rnam rtog gis byas pa

'i shes bya yin zhing*/ rgyu rkyen ldan dang med 'dzin gnyis su 'dus sogs/ sna tshogs lta ba thams cad kyang lus sems kyi/ gzung 'dzin la brten nas 'byung bar tshangs pa dra ba'i mdo las gsungs/ bye mdo rnams phyi rol rdul phran sems las gzhan par mngon sum dang phag na mo sogs 'dod pa ni/ kun gzhi yid bcas yul snang gi/ nus pa ma rtogs dbang gis ste sems las gzhan du med do// 'on kyang bdag dang sogs byed pa po sogs yod rtog /dgag phyir rgyal bas gsungs pa yod byang chub sems 'grel las/ bdag tu 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ phung po khams sogs bstan pa yin/ nyan thos sde pa 'ga' zhig gis bdag dang gang zag khas len pa de yang btags par brjod/ bden pa'i rdzas grub rdul tsam med/ gal te yod na de myang 'das kyi chos su yod na 'bad med thar pa'am/ 'khor ba'i chos su yod na thar med skyon 'gyur zhes su bstan/ de sogs sems la snang ba yin/ sems tsam pa la gnas nas ni/ skal chen rnams kyis de yang spang dang spang gnyen mkhas rnams kyis gsungs bzhin/ rdo rje theg pa 'dir ni sems kun gzhi'i yul snang kun gzhi'i rten lus 'di la lus rten nas ni g.yo ba yin/ rtsa rlung thig le'i dag pa dang ma dag pa'i nges pa yi las/ spang gnyen de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ khyad par khams drug ldan rdo rje'i lus ldan pa'i/ skyes bu lo brgya'i dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya la zhag gcig byas pa'i lo yin/ phyi'i nyin zhag bgrang ba'i lo min/ shin tu phra ba lus skyes kyi srin bu ni mi'i zhag gcig la lo brgyad rdzogs/ che ba 'og min gyi lha'i dbugs khug gcig la mi'i lo gcig 'di'i lo brgya gzugs med gong ma'i dbugs gcig /de ltar sems can thams cad rang dbugs kyi lo brgya par gsungs/ rlung ji snyed/ bsdoms na bye ba bdun cu bdun/ sa ya bdun dang 'bum phrag drug

/yod pas sbyang gzhi de sbyong ba'i// chos sgo de dang mnyam pa yin/ brgyad khri bzhi stong rags rim grangs/ de la ye shes rlung zhag rer drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ji snyed/ rgyu ba bsdoms pas sa ya nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'bum phrag gsum myang 'das lam ldan pa/ gnyen po'i mchog ste bla med rgyud/ de phyir lo brgya'i ye shes rlung*/ sde tshan du bsdoms pas lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi/ lo gsum zhag ni stong brgyad cu/ lo gsum sku gsung thugs dbye bas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gsum ste/ bgrod pa gnyis re thabs shes dbye bas rigs drug rgyud du bshad/ lo gsum po de lam zla ba'i so drug 'byung ba'i dbye ba'i rigs rnams ni/ sum cu so drug rgyud du bshad de de dag ni bsdus brgyud do// so drug so sos g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab kyi/ dbye bas thabs dang shes rab rgyud/ rtsa rgyud bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod// 'di ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ru/ phyag grangs dag par gsung pa yin/ a sogs dbyangs ni a e ṛ u l̥/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la bco lnga/ ring po bco lnga dang sum cu stong chen yig lnga rjes su nga ro dang sum cu drug /ka sogs ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ pa ny+pa ṣa sha ྈྐ/ gsal byed de dag mnyam/ 1$1000240 sum cu ha ma ra wa la k+ṣa dang drug / brjod byed yi ge gtso bor gsungs/ gsal byed re re'ang dbyangs sum cus bsgyur bas rgyud phran sum cu ste/ de la dbyangs gsal gnyis phye na stong dang brgyad brgya yin par bshad de dus sbyor gcig 1$1000240 gi rlung dang grangs mnyam pas rgyud sde'i dbye ba yang de dang mnyam/ de zhag tu longs pa la nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yi yod pas/ rgyud kyi yan lag gi grangs kyang ldan pa ste/ de re re yang thig le sku tsheg drag gsung gri gug thugs gi/ dbye bas thung ring shin tu ring

ring po gsum yi dbye bas nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/ lo gcig gi zhag grags la sbyar ba/ gsal byed sum cu dbyangs drug gi bsgyur brgya brgyad cu de yang dbyangs gsal so sor phye bas sum brgya drug cu rtsa ba'i dbyangs/ zhag gcig gi chu tshod drug cu'i nyin mtshan dbyangs kyang drug cu ste/ de phyir dbugs grangs zhag gcig dang*/ lo gcig chu tshod gnyis dbyangs mthun grangs phyir/ gsal byed de dang mtshungs pa yin/ zhib tu rtsis kyi dbyangs 'char nang du ltos/ bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi tshogs kyi/ rnam dbye bsdus par bstan pa yin/ de ni rgyud nas bstan pa'i lha grangs ye shes kyi rlung la sbyar ba thabs shes gnyis med rgyud dus 'khor/ de dag gtso bo cung zad brjod/ lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi lo gsum zhag stong brgyad cu la res gza' bdun gyis bgos/ brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi ste/ dus 'khor nyung ngu'i thugs dkyil gyi pad gdan can gyi lha grangs ste/ lhag gnyis thabs shes gtso bo yab yum bdag nyid gsungs/ lo gsum gyi zla ba'i cha ni bco lnga ste/ des phye bgos pas bdun cu rtsa gnyis thob te/ bdag po 'khrig thabs gtso bo dang lhag gi bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ nges brjod dam mngon brjod 'bum pa'i rgyud kyi sdom pa chen po'i lha ru bshad/ de las gnyis gnyis bsdus na dpa' mo sum cu bdun/ thabs dpa' bo gcig dang bcas sdom pa chu ngu'i lha de ye shes kyi rlung lus la lha dpa' bo gcig las mi yong ba ni bde chen ris med dang stong nyid rnam bcas du mar 'gyur bas dpa' mor bzhag pa'o gnas pa'i dbang las byung*/ zla phyed phyogs gsum gyi zhag de dag /khyad par thabs kyi rgyud kyi lha yin pas/ dus sbyor phyogs gsum gyi zhag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga la rgyu ba bcu gnyis kyis/ dbye bas bsgyur ba las lnga brgya bzhi bcu yin/ de la sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni/

rnam gsum zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ zhe lnga zhe gsum de dag zung yin pas nang ses su rnams so// nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa bzhi yin/ sgyu dra'i lhag ma ni dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa rnam drug ste/ dgu dang bcu gsum dang bcu dgu dang*/ nyer lnga so gnyis dang so bzhi ste/ dge thabs dang shes rab dbye ba yis/ nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa bzhi'o/ pha rgyud thabs shes ma rgyud dang bcas grangs rnams so/ thod pa nye lnga ma dang rdo rje bdud rtsi dang*/ dgyes rdor sogs rnams ma rgyud kyi/ sdom pa'i che chung nang du 'dus par gsungs/ gshin rje gshed dang rta mgrin sogs gsang ba 'dus par bar bsdu/ ngag dbang chos dbyings gsung dbang dus kyi 'khor lor 'dus sogs/ dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor can yang dus 'khor du/ rnal 'byor rgyud kun kyang pha rgyud du 'dus te/ bya spyod rnams ni de yi yan lag yin/ de ni ye shes rlung lha thams cad sbyar ba bshad do/ rtsa yang de la yang sbyar zhing thig le dkar cha rlung dang dmar cha rtsa dang chos mthun pas 'dir 'du ba'o bzhin gsungs pa yin/ snying ga srog rtsa dbu ma ni dus 'khor lo/ ro rkyang zhabs kyi rang bzhin te/ snying gar 'khor lo drug gi lte ba'i mi shigs pa ni sangs rgyas drug snying ga'i rtsa brgyad du sogs lha mo brgyad/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin bdud bral ma sna tshogs yum du brjod/ bum pa brgyad ni bshang ba gci ba sha dang rkang*/ khu khrag rnams kyi rtsa yin te gtsug tor rtsa bzhi ni/ nor bu gaṇ+ḍi shing dang dung*/ phung po drug khams drug gi rtsa rnams sangs rgyas drug dang de'i yum/ mig sogs dbang po drug dang gzugs sogs yul drug gi rtsa rnams ni/ byang chub sems dpa' drug lha mor sems ma drug bcas/ rkang pa sogs las dbang khro bo drug de'i bya ba drug gi khro bo drug khro mo drug bcu/ lte ba'i rtsa don gnyis rnams 'jigs ma sogs/

gsung gi dkyil 'khor lha'i rang bzhin yin/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis ni lha chen bcu gnyis rtsa'i 'khor lo rtsa sum brgya drug cu ni sku yi dkyil 'khor gnas pa yin/ sor tshigs kyi rtsa rnams klu dang gtum mo ste/ ba spu 'i rtsa rnams 'byung po'i rang bzhin skra sa bla mchan bu sa steng gsang ba'i spu sa 'og gi grub pa dang sbyar ba'o no// 'dod dang mi 'dod rtog pa kun/ mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa/ de dag kyang rtsa shes rab khams thabs dang shes rab kyi/ dbye bas phye ba stong dang brgyad cu'o// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa ni/ gtso bo dbu ma ro rkyang zhabs rtsa gsum bdud bral ma phag mo bcas pa dang*/ snying gar phyogs rtsa bzhi yum bzhi mtshams rtsa bzhi mchod pa bzhi/ rtsa chen nyer bzhi rnal 'byor ma/ rab gtum ma sogs nyer bzhi yin de nang khams/ thod pa'i dum sogs dpa' bor nyer bzhir gsungs/ khwa gdong ma la sogs brgyad khro bcur gsungs/ nyis 'gyur gyi sdom chen ni rtsa nyer bzhi la

thim dang longs spyod bdag po'i phyir/ lha ni bdud cu gnyis rang bzhin/ 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab brgya nyi shu/ lha ru mngon brjod dang rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsungs/ dpal ldan 'dus pa bshad bya ba/ phung po rtsa sangs rgyas lnga yin te/ sa sogs khams bzhi reg bya dang bcas lha mo lnga/ mig rtsa gnyis sa yi snying po ste/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje'o// sna ni nam mkha'i snying po ste/ lce la bzhugs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug /yid ni 'jam dpal chos khams rnams la/ sgrib sel yin te lus la ni/ kun tu bzang po nyid ces bya/ rtsa rgyus byams pa nyid yin no// yan lag tshigs mkhrig ma dang long bu mi the ba brgyad dang kha dang gsang ba// khro bo bcu yi rang bzhin te// lte bar sa las kyi rigs skyes pa/ mkhyen ma dang gtum mo sogs lha mo ni/ drug cu rtsa bzhi gsungs pa yin/ rdo rje dbyings sogs snying gar chu 1$1000240dgu /rdo rje'i rigs su gsungs pa ste// pad+ma'i sgrol ma sogs bcu drug /mgrin par me pad+ma'i rang bzhin la// spyi bor rlung rab tu pad ma la sogs// 'khor lo rigs ldan sum cu gnyis yod pa sogs/ /rgyas par rdo rje phreng bar gsungs// de sogs dkyil 'khor du ma rnams/ rkyang pa phyogs re cha ldan pa/ gsungs pa thams cad 'dir 'dus te/ dper na rkyang pa'i dbang du dgyes rdor lha dgu ni/ snying ga'i 'khor lo rkyang pa la bzhag pa yin zhing*/ thams cad lus kyi rtsa rlung yin las byung ste spyi bo nas 'jam dpal sku dang gshin rje gshed sogs nas yan man nas ma mo nying lag nas 'jig rten mchod bstod smod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs/ mdor na rtsa ni sku yin te lam du bskyed rim/ rlung ni sngags dang yi ge'o// thig le phra mo'i bde ba yin te lam du rdzogs rim sgom mo/ de bzhin sbyin sreg sogs las rnams kun/ nang gi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed yin/ 'dir ni phyogs tsam brjod pa'o// de bzhin sa dang lam dang gzungs

dang*/ ting 'dzin rab 'byams sogs phar phyin nas gsungs pa'i ye shes thams cad lha dang sngags kyi rim par/ lus sems snang ba'i dbye ba las/ brten nas thams cad gzigs pas gsungs/ zab mo nang gi don snang bar byed pa las chos kyi sbya1$1000240nga gzhi dang sbyong byed bstan pa ste dgu pa'o// ༈ //de ltar rtsa rlung byang sems gnas skabs bzhi phyi snod lus la sbyar ba rnams shes par bya ba'i gzhi yin la/ kun brtags kyi lha sgom bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar bshad kyis ni 'ching bar byed pa'i thabs brjod nas de la brten pa'i lam bgrod tshul rtsa rlung thig le gsum/ sems kyi cha las snang ba ste/ sems kyi ngo bo la 'khor 'das gnyis khyad med kyang sems kyi rten rtsa rlung thig le dag ma dag gi 'khor 'das su snang ba de phyir rdo rje'i lus 'di don lcags gser du bsgyur ba ltar gnad 'ching ba/ nyan rang phar phyin gyi lam rim kun las khyad par 'phags ste sangs rgya ba nges par sngags lam la brten dgos pas so/ ga nyan thos ni lta ba gang zag bdag med bsam pa dang zhi ba tsam/ 'bras bu shin tu myur bas tshe gcig myur ba tsam srid pa lan gsum ste/ rgyun zhugs 'gor na'ang lan bdun mi'i skye ba bdun lha'i skye ba bdun de gnyis kyi bar srid bdun yin/ de ni rang don zhi ba tsam/ rang rgyal tshogs spyod chung ngu bskal pa nyi shu nas/ bse ru lta bu'i bskal pa brgya yis rang gi byang chub 'grub/ sems can thams cad phan byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas shing skyo ba med par bskal pa grangs med gsum/ 'dir ni lam gyi dngos gzhi phar phyin dag mtshungs la/ drung rang gi rtag gnyis 'grel par/ sngags kyi sgrub mtha' ni lta ba dbu ma pa la thabs khyad par 'phags te/ khag cig thabs bzhin lta ba yang lhag zer ste dpyad dgos thabs kyi khyad par gyis/ pha rol phyin pa'i

de la khyad 'phags lam de la/ bya spyod rigs gsum gyi lha dang lha'i snying po gsang sngags rigs rang rang gi sngags rnam rgyal sogs gzungs sngags kyis rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i tshul gyi thabs mkhas tsam/ ldan yang lo brgya pa'i mi tshe lo drug stong drug cu ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sngags dang phyag rgya ldan na mi tshes bcu drug lo drug stong drug brgyas yin/ bla na med pa tshe gcig gis/ brtson ldan lo gsum phyogs gsum du sa lam bgrod nas nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ dang por bla ma mtshan ldan la dbang don ngo 'phrod thob bskyed rdzogs ni/ legs shes nyam kyi rgyu bde gshegs snying po rkyen bla ma la mos mos sgrub kun gzhi'i sogs bar ma chad rgyun sbyor gyi brtson 'grus 1$1000240 sgrub tshogs lam ste rgyud la yid ches slob dpon la yid ches rang gi myong ba la yid ches pa lung rjes dpag mngon sum tshad ma gsum yi sgo nas tshogs lam chen por rgyun chos kyi ting 'dzin ni 'dir sgrub pa la rtse gcig pa sangs rgyas las gdam ngag nod pa/ de bzhin du dran nye bzhi 'dir bde mchog lta bur mkha' 'gro ma bzhi sgom pa yin te/ lus gtsang 'dzin ni sems yin/ sems de bskyed pa'i brten rlung thig yin pas sa bon lam lta bu las mkha' 'gro ma zhal phyag gi rnam pa can bsgom pa dang gzungs dkyil kyang rung*/ des na gzhi 'gyur lam zhes rnam pa rtog pas lhar bsgyur lam yin te/ rtog pas brtags pa de yang dngos dang mthun par brtags pas so/ gzhi dngos po'i lam ni rdzogs rim ste rags pa dang phra lus kyi gnad bcings pas shin tu phra lus stong gzugs mthong ba ni lus dran nye tshor ba bde chen du shar ba tshor dran sems so so rang gis rig pa sems dran/ sems thams cad zung 'jug tu rtogs pa chos dran/ yang na/ lus lha lha sems stong pa stong pa bde chen du shar ba la lus sems chos tshor ba dran nyer yang bzhed/
